tool.name: nf-core miranda
tool.description: miRanda is an algorithm for finding genomic targets for microRNAs
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ miranda \\ $mirbase \\ $query \\ $args \\ -out ${prefix}.out
echo "miRNA\tTarget\tScore\tEnergy_KcalMol\tQuery_Start\tQuery_End\tSubject_Start\tSubject_End\tAln_len\tSubject_Identity\tQuery_Identity" > ${prefix}.txt grep -A 1 "Scores for this hit:" ${prefix}.out | sort | grep ">" | cut -c 2- | tr ' ' '\t' >> ${prefix}.txt
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": miranda: \$(echo \$(miranda -v | sed -n 4p | sed 's/^.*miranda v//; s/microRNA.*\$//' )) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:

miRanda is an algorithm for finding genomic targets for microRNAs
